svg.text: Reference design of the Node 1 status display
On a 128 × 64 pixel grid · sizes and coordinates are taken from the Practice 6 sketch
temperature at x 0 · humidity right-aligned to x 122 · °C, % size 1
icon x 0 · name x 11 · number right-aligned to x 82
inverted (white background) when there is motion
Test the worst cases before you use your design:
-40.0 °C and 100% in the top band: there is still a gap between them
4095 (four digits) still ends at x = 82, before the bar
temperature NAN → "--.-", humidity -1 → "--", water level -1 → "--" with an empty bar
main numbers in the top 16 rows, which are yellow; the rest is blue
change at least two things, then repeat the test with the four Practice 6 samples
